name: M4 EasingPicker, CarouselPager and DockLayerGroup in a 300 px column
do: eval:(()=>{const box=document.querySelector("[data-testid=fold-m4]");if(!box)return 'none';const R=box.getBoundingClientRect();const o=[];for(const e of box.querySelectorAll('*')){const c=getComputedStyle(e);if(c.display==='none')continue;const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width)continue;const past=Math.max(R.left-r.left,r.right-R.right);const inner=e.scrollWidth-e.clientWidth;if((past>0.5||(e.clientWidth>0&&inner>1&&!/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(e.tagName)))&&o.length<8)o.push((e.getAttribute('data-slot')||e.className.toString().split(' ')[0]||e.tagName)+' past '+Math.round(past*10)/10+' sw-cw '+inner+' ox '+c.overflowX)}return {box:box.scrollWidth+'/'+box.clientWidth,n:o.length,o}})()
